scope: Complete district specialization for all 28 productive goods and markets, including crops, coastal fisheries and extended minerals.
Keep workshop workplaces tied to the same processing-sector catalogue; retain exact majority ties and physical cell ownership.
Exercise real suitable sites when funding every facility kind; complete commodity inventories in affected shipment and labor fixtures.
Verify packed saves preserve exhausted mineral reserves and the shared current-month fishing quota through deterministic renewal.
Document the implemented catalogue and distinguish remaining roadmap work from current production.
validationEnvironment: An archive of the base commit with only the resource-industry completion patch applied, using the existing dependency installation. Separate investment, politics, mapping and demographic workspace changes were excluded.

checks.scope: Both shared workspace and isolated resource patch; isolated build includes final production code.

checks.command: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-timeout=120000 tests/extended-economy.test.ts tests/production-chains.test.ts tests/productive-facilities.test.ts tests/natural-resources.test.ts

node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern='local resource availability|industrial employment refines|saved shipments cannot|nonfarm workplace access' tests/district-economy.test.ts tests/spatial.test.ts tests/adaptive-world.test.ts tests/settlement-dynamics.test.ts

checks.scope: Repository formatter; the isolated changed TypeScript files also pass Prettier checks.

checks.qualification: The default whole-suite launch was stopped during excessive parallel worker startup. This is not a full-suite pass; targeted checks above used bounded concurrency.

regressionEvidence.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='every commissioned facility|new primary facilities' tests/productive-facilities.test.ts
regressionEvidence.withoutFix: Both new specialization tests fail: grain-farm is unclassified and the new primary-sector tie is ignored.
regressionEvidence.withFix: Both tests pass as part of the isolated 75-test run.

refinement.design: Compile facility activity groups once from the commodity/facility catalogues; share the industrial group with public workshop capacity.
refinement.functions: Reviewed mean-level summation, workplace apportionment, rounded tier-majority selection, suitable-site fixtures and saved extraction continuation.
refinement.performance: Grouping is bounded by the 29 facility kinds with no per-query arrays. Existing geographic means remain cached. A deterministic 100,000-query contract verifies specialization and capacity reads never rescan district cells.
refinement.documentation: Comments explain primary-sector grouping, cached means, integer majority ties and geography-aware construction fixtures. Catalogue counts and roadmap persistence claims match the current implementation.

limitations: No claim of a complete repository test-suite pass or world-scale simulation throughput benchmark.
Chemistry, limestone/lime, detailed livestock, offshore fisheries and paid delayed plant conversions remain future roadmap work.
Unrelated working-tree changes are excluded; no push or deployment is part of this task.
